description: WP-C7 Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) PRAESIDIUM SHIELD (Shield-Captain): -1 Damage to each attack allocated to the bearer, shown in the damage log. Fixture cus11e_c7_enemy_shoot (P1 Orks' Shooting phase vs P2 Custodes). A real token click selects the Tankbustas; their Busta rokkit launchas (Damage 3) are declared at the Shield-Captain with the phase actions the shooting panel sends and resolved by real clicks on Fast Roll / Complete Shooting. Every unsaved rokkit does 2 damage (the Shield-Captain loses exactly 2 wounds per Praesidium line) and the shooting dice log shows 'Praesidium Shield: -1 Damage (3 -> 2) — attack allocated to Shield-Captain'. P2's Vengeful Surge window then opens and is declined by a real click; the Dice Log tab is opened for the screenshot. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; both players have 0 CP (no paid stratagem competes; abilities cost none); the Shield-Captain's wounds inflated to 99 (the count of lost wounds is the evidence).

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
for m in GameState.state.units["U_SHIELD_CAPTAIN_A"].models:
	m["wounds"] = 99
	m["current_wounds"] = 99
return true
